items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, from a point of a site and an element of the value of the point at an object, a point of the localized site whose stalk is the stalk at the original point of the pullback along the localization (statement lines 8884-8904). The proof is a complete argument: the point is represented by a set-valued functor and the localization lemma gives the localized morphism of topoi with its commutative diagram (proof lines 8907-8925); the author then uses the identification of the category of sets with the slice over the chosen element to produce a continuous functor on the localized site and verifies that it agrees with the composite of the localized functor with the functor coming from the point (proof lines 8926-8958); the conclusion follows by construction (proof lines 8959-8963). The non-formal content is the construction of the induced functor through the slice identification. The claim is H2: a construction with each input named.
